text_es: Escribir tu historia para La Viña o Grapevine es trabajo del Paso ___: le lleva el mensaje a otro alcohólico.
explain_es: Una historia escrita hoy puede llegar a alguien años después, en una prisión, un hospital o una biblioteca.
notes: LV guidelines: your article is a Twelfth Step, it carries the message (paraphrased). GVR Handbook (2024) p. 12: writing is Twelfth Step work; a story may reach someone years later in a prison, hospital or library (paraphrased). research.md C1, C2.

text_en: Manuscripts aren't sent back, so keep a ___ of your story before you send it.
explain_en: Writers aren't paid for their stories. Sending yours to Grapevine? Use the website or email, not both.
text_es: Los manuscritos no se devuelven: guarda una ___ de tu historia antes de enviarla.
explain_es: No se paga por las historias. ¿Envías la tuya a Grapevine? Usa el sitio web o el correo electrónico, no los dos.
notes: GV guidelines (read 2026-10-02): keep a copy, manuscripts cannot be returned; do not submit via the website what you already sent by email. GV Editorial Policy: no payment, material not returned. La Vina Politica Editorial (2020): contributions unpaid and not returned. Paraphrased. research.md C6, C8, A7.

text_en: Grapevine and La Viña come in three formats: print, digital and ___.
explain_en: Read them on paper or on a screen, or listen. Audio stories come with digital subscriptions; check the store for what each plan includes.
text_es: La Viña y Grapevine vienen en tres formatos: impreso, digital y ___.
explain_es: Léelas en papel o en pantalla, o escúchalas. Las historias en audio vienen con las suscripciones digitales; revisa en la tienda qué incluye cada plan.
notes: aa.org: international journals of AA in print, digital and audio (read 2026-10-02). Audio-with-digital wording exactly as research.md Open question 8 suggests (which plan includes audio is Medium).

text_en: Unscramble it! A Grapevine editor wrote it, and it first appeared in the June 1947 issue.
explain_en: The AA Preamble says what AA is and what it is not. Its wording was updated after the 2021 General Service Conference (“men and women” became “people”).
text_es: ¡Ordena las letras! Lo escribió un editor del Grapevine, y apareció por primera vez en el número de junio de 1947.
explain_es: El Preámbulo de AA dice qué es AA y qué no es. Su texto en inglés se actualizó tras la Conferencia de Servicios Generales de 2021 («men and women» pasó a ser «people»).
notes: P-52, p. 5 (written by one of Grapevine's first editors, June 1947) and p. 2 (under the Preamble: revised per the 2021 General Service Conference); M-39, p. 57; Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 170.

text_en: Unscramble it! Bill W. first sketched these out in the April 1946 Grapevine.
explain_en: The Twelve Traditions. Today they appear in the magazine regularly, along with the Steps and the Preamble.
text_es: ¡Ordena las letras! Bill W. las esbozó por primera vez en el Grapevine de abril de 1946.
explain_es: Las Doce Tradiciones. Hoy aparecen con regularidad en la revista, junto con los Pasos y el Preámbulo.
notes: Regular appearance of the Steps, Traditions and Preamble: aagrapevine.org/evolution-magazine; GVR Handbook 2024, p. 7 (they appear in every issue).

text_en: Unscramble it: free, weekly and full of AA members' stories. Listen on the drive to your home group!
explain_en: The AA Grapevine Half-Hour Variety Hour comes out on Mondays, free on aagrapevine.org and in podcast apps.
text_es: Ordena las letras: gratis, semanal y lleno de historias de miembros de AA. ¡Escúchalo camino a tu grupo base!
explain_es: El podcast de Grapevine (en inglés) sale los lunes, gratis en aagrapevine.org y en las apps de podcasts.
notes: Answer: 7 letters in both languages. Mondays: data/site/episodes.json (every Monday since Oct. 4, 2021) and Workbook 2026 p. 14; free: aagrapevine.org/podcasts.

text_en: Clue: La Viña celebrates one every July. In 2026 it was the 30th.
explain_en: Anniversary! 1996–2026: thirty years of La Viña, since its first issue.
text_es: Pista: La Viña celebra uno cada julio. En 2026 fue el 30.º.
explain_es: ¡Aniversario! 1996–2026: treinta años de La Viña, desde su primer número.
notes: 'La Viña 30 Aniversario' postcard (aalavina.org/recursos); anniversary in July: Grapevine Workbook (2026), p. 60.

text_en: Clue: what the name La Viña means in English, a place where grapes grow.
explain_en: Vineyard! Since the new magazine would have an identity of its own, it was given a name of its own.
text_es: Pista: otra palabra para «viña», el lugar donde se cultivan las uvas.
explain_es: ¡Viñedo! Como la revista nueva iba a tener identidad propia, recibió un nombre propio.
notes: 'Historia de La Viña' (aalavina.org/recursos, rev. Aug. 2020): why the name (its own identity, so its own name). Its mention of wine is left out on purpose.

text_en: Clue: one story topic La Viña suggests is what you learned from this person who guides you through the Steps.
explain_en: Your sponsor! It's one of La Viña's suggested story topics. Write it down, or record it by phone.
text_es: Pista: uno de los temas que sugiere La Viña es lo que aprendiste de esta persona que te guía en los Pasos.
explain_es: ¡Tu padrino (o madrina)! Es uno de los temas que sugiere La Viña. Escríbelo o grábalo por teléfono.
notes: aalavina.org/temas-sugeridos (topic list paraphrased, not copied).

text_en: Unscramble it (two words): La Viña's is free on the App Store and Google Play, and now you can get it anywhere in the world.
explain_en: Download it free; reading La Viña in it needs a digital or Complete subscription.
text_es: Ordena las letras: la de La Viña es gratis en App Store y Google Play, y ahora se descarga en todo el mundo.
explain_es: Descárgala gratis; para leer La Viña en ella necesitas una suscripción digital o completa.
notes: MOBILE APP = 9 letters; APLICACIÓN = 10 letters. Worldwide: La Viña News, Sept.-Oct. 2026 (research.md A5, High).

text_en: Every member has one, and Grapevine and La Viña are full of them.
explain_en: Your story could be exactly what another alcoholic needs to read. Ask us how to send it in.
text_es: Todo miembro tiene una, y La Viña y Grapevine están llenas de ellas.
explain_es: Tu historia puede ser justo lo que otro alcohólico necesita leer. Pregúntanos cómo enviarla.
notes: Who writes them: AA members write almost all the stories (P-52 p. 9; Service Manual p. 81; research.md A1). Wording follows /contribute/ subtitle.

text_en: Bylines protect it: first name and last initial only, or no name at all.
explain_en: Your full name stays with the office. In Grapevine, you choose how it appears: first name and last initial, initials only, or "Anonymous."
text_es: Las firmas lo protegen: solo nombre de pila e inicial del apellido, o ningún nombre.
explain_es: Tu nombre completo se queda en la oficina. En Grapevine eliges cómo aparece: nombre de pila e inicial, solo iniciales o «Anónimo».
notes: Submit form byline options (read 2026-10-02): First and Last Initials Only / First Name and Last Initial / Anonymous. SMF-197 p. 1: first names and last initials in printed articles (research.md Q17, D2). The three options are verified for Grapevine only, so the Spanish text says 'En Grapevine'.

text_en: Members, pens, paper and coffee, writing their stories together. (Hint: a writing …)
explain_en: Didn't finish? Take your story home and send it in when it's ready. Our committee can help your group or district plan a writing workshop. Ask us!
text_es: Miembros, plumas, papel y café para escribir juntos sus historias. (Pista: un … de escritura)
explain_es: ¿No terminaste? Llévate tu historia a casa y envíala cuando esté lista. Nuestro comité puede ayudar a tu grupo o distrito a organizar un taller de escritura. ¡Pregúntanos!
notes: Writing Workshop Guidelines (aagrapevine.org/gvr-resources, dated 1.12.21, read 2026-10-02): pens and paper on hand; 'If you don't finish, please take your story home and finish it' (paraphrased). research.md C11. Committee offer = /contribute/#workshop (read.contrib.ws_text). Not used: 'each member sends their own story' (the official guidelines suggest collecting the stories; research.md Don't 14 still applies: never send a story without its writer's consent).

text_en: Unscramble it: almost every Grapevine story since 1944 lives here, for digital subscribers.
explain_en: The Story Archive opens with a digital or Complete subscription, on the web and in the app. La Viña's archive goes back to 1996.
text_es: Ordena las letras: aquí viven las historias de La Viña desde 1996 y casi todas las de Grapevine desde 1944.
explain_es: El archivo se abre con una suscripción digital o completa, en la web y en la aplicación.
credit_es: Fuente: Manual de Servicio de A.A.; aalavina.org
notes: A.A. Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 83; La Viña Hoy 2025 (1996); aagrapevine.org/apps and aalavina.org/aplicaciones (subscription opens the archive). Spanish clue reordered so La Viña comes first.

text_en: Unscramble it (two words): a free line from a Grapevine story, in your inbox every day.
explain_en: Sign up free on aagrapevine.org. La Viña's version, in Spanish, is the Cita Diaria on aalavina.org.
text_es: Ordena las letras (dos palabras): una frase breve de una historia publicada, que La Viña te envía gratis cada día por correo.
explain_es: Inscríbete gratis en aalavina.org. La versión de Grapevine, en inglés, es el Daily Quote.
notes: DAILY QUOTE = 10 letters; CITA DIARIA = 10 letters. research.md A5 (High); La Viña News Sept.-Oct. 2026 p. 2 (free by email). ES clue said 'una historia de La Viña', but the Cita Diaria can quote a translated Grapevine book, so it now says 'una historia publicada'.

text_en: Unscramble it: not much of a writer? You can do this with your story by phone, for Grapevine or La Viña.
explain_en: Grapevine's Audio Project takes stories of 6 to 8 minutes; La Viña's Graba tu historia, up to 7. Both also take WAV or MP3 files by email.
text_es: Ordena las letras: ¿escribir no es lo tuyo? Puedes hacer esto con tu historia por teléfono para La Viña o Grapevine.
explain_es: «Graba tu historia» de La Viña acepta hasta 7 minutos; el Proyecto de Audio de Grapevine, de 6 a 8. Las dos también reciben archivos WAV o MP3 por correo.
notes: aagrapevine.org/audio-portal and aalavina.org/graba-tu-historia (data/site/audio_project.json, checked 2026-10-02). Spanish twin: {site_es}contribute/.

text_en: In the 1940s, AA members serving overseas wrote to a full page called “Mail Call for All AAs in the Armed Forces.” They named the Grapevine their “meeting in print,” and today Grapevine and La Viña carry the phrase on their covers.
text_es: En los años 40, miembros de AA que servían en el extranjero escribían a una página entera llamada «Mail Call for All AAs in the Armed Forces». Llamaron al Grapevine su «reunión impresa», y hoy La Viña y Grapevine llevan la frase en sus portadas.
notes: Also P-52, p. 13 (research.md A1).

text_en: Early Grapevines mixed members' first-person stories with AA news, book reviews and even pieces by well-known writers who weren't AA members. Little by little, members' stories took over the pages.
text_es: Los primeros Grapevine mezclaban historias de miembros en primera persona con noticias de AA, reseñas de libros y hasta textos de escritores famosos que no eran de AA. Poco a poco, las historias de los miembros llenaron sus páginas.
notes: Also aagrapevine.org/history-aa-grapevine (book reviews, reprints, pieces by nonAAs including well-known literary figures). No writers named.

text_en: By its fourth issue, the Grapevine described itself under its masthead as a monthly journal hoping to unite alcoholics everywhere, and noted that the opinions in it weren't necessarily AA's as a whole.
text_es: Desde su cuarto número, el Grapevine se describía bajo su cabecera como una revista mensual que esperaba unir a los alcohólicos de todas partes, y aclaraba que las opiniones publicadas no eran necesariamente las de AA en su conjunto.
notes: Paraphrase of the masthead description quoted on the history page (both sentences are in the same italic block there, checked 2026-10-02). Grapevine copyright: do not quote it.

text_en: Laughter has always had a place in the Grapevine. Its first cartoon ran in issue number three, and in its second year a humor feature called “Barley Corn” joined the fun.
text_es: La risa siempre ha tenido su lugar en el Grapevine. Su primera caricatura salió en el número tres, y en su segundo año se sumó una sección de humor llamada «Barley Corn».
notes: Not 'Victor E. 1958' (unverified; research.md A2).

text_en: A volunteer Grapevine illustrator painted “The Man on the Bed” for the December 1955 issue. Many AAs cherish it as a reminder of the Twelfth Step call Bill W. and Dr. Bob made on AA number three.
text_es: Un ilustrador voluntario del Grapevine pintó «The Man on the Bed» (El hombre en la cama) para el número de diciembre de 1955. Muchos AA atesoran esa pintura como recuerdo de la visita de Paso Doce que Bill W. y el Dr. Bob le hicieron al AA número tres.
notes: Also aagrapevine.org/evolution-magazine (volunteer illustrator, centerfold). Painter not named (anonymity). Never show the painting (Grapevine artwork).

text_en: The Grapevine printed the Serenity Prayer in its early issues, and that helped the prayer spread throughout AA. Since July 1967, it has appeared in the magazine regularly.
text_es: El Grapevine publicó la Oración de la Serenidad en sus primeros números, y eso ayudó a que se difundiera en toda la Comunidad. Desde julio de 1967 aparece con regularidad en la revista.

text_en: The Conference Charter says: “…nothing herein shall compromise the Grapevine editor's right to accept or reject material for publication.”
credit_en: Reprinted from The A.A. Service Manual, 2024–2026 Edition, p. 81, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
text_es: La Carta Constitutiva de la Conferencia protege el derecho del editor del Grapevine a aceptar o rechazar material para su publicación.
credit_es: Fuente: The A.A. Service Manual, edición 2024–2026 (en inglés), p. 81
notes: English: research.md Q12, word for word, with its exact credit line. Spanish: our own paraphrase (no official Spanish text in research.md), so no quotation marks. Re-check the page number when the 2026-2028 Service Manual is out.

text_en: What works for one member may not work for another, so two Grapevine stories may seem to disagree. The editors welcome that variety, guided by the Twelve Traditions.
text_es: Lo que le funciona a un miembro puede no funcionarle a otro, así que dos historias del Grapevine pueden parecer contradecirse. Los editores dan cabida a esa variedad, guiados por las Doce Tradiciones.
notes: Paraphrase of Grapevine's Editorial Policy (Grapevine copyright: do not quote).

text_en: A former Grapevine editor, who also served as a trustee, wrote the Responsibility Statement for AA's 1965 International Convention in Toronto. In July that year, Bill W. explored its theme in a Grapevine essay.
text_es: Un antiguo editor del Grapevine, que también fue custodio, escribió la Declaración de Responsabilidad para la Convención Internacional de AA de 1965, en Toronto. En julio de ese año, Bill W. profundizó en su tema en un ensayo del Grapevine.
notes: Author not named (anonymity; research.md Q3). Bill W.'s essay: 'Responsibility Is Our Theme', July 1965. aalavina.org/sobre-nosotros says the same.

text_en: Starting in 1944, Bill W. wrote about 150 articles for the Grapevine, among them “The Next Frontier: Emotional Sobriety,” in January 1958.
text_es: A partir de 1944, Bill W. escribió unos 150 artículos para el Grapevine, entre ellos «The Next Frontier: Emotional Sobriety» (sobre la sobriedad emocional), en enero de 1958.
notes: About 150: The A.A. Service Manual 2024-2026 (research.md A2) and GVR Handbook 2024, p. 7 (150); the official store pages say more than 150, from 1944 to 1970 (aalavina.org/tienda/el-lenguaje-del-corazon: June 1944 to December 1970). The Service Manual says 1944-1971, so no end year is given (and never 'Dec. 1970 last article', research.md A2). Jan. 1958 essay: GVR Workbook 2026, p. 17 (checked 2026-10-03).

text_en: A short piece is an easy first step: a letter for Dear Grapevine, an opinion for What's On Your Mind?, a clean joke for At Wit's End, or a photo of your meeting place (no people!) for If Walls Could Talk.
text_es: Un texto breve es un primer paso fácil en Grapevine: una carta para Dear Grapevine, una opinión para What's On Your Mind?, un chiste sano para At Wit's End o una foto de tu sala de reunión (¡sin personas!) para If Walls Could Talk.
notes: GV guidelines (read 2026-10-02): What's On Your Mind?, jokes for At Wit's End, letters for Dear Grapevine, meeting photos without people for If Walls Could Talk. GVR Workbook 2026 p. 36 (If Walls Could Talk) and p. 45 (Dear Grapevine and What's on Your Mind? are the departments some members find easier to write for; At Wit's End = jokes and cartoons). research.md C3. Grapevine's section names kept in English. Never claim La Viña has these sections.

text_en: Grapevine generally edits stories lightly, for clarity, style and length, and doesn't change them once they're published. At least three people read each story before it's chosen.
text_es: Por lo general, Grapevine edita las historias con un toque ligero, para darles claridad, estilo y la extensión adecuada, y no las cambia una vez publicadas. Al menos tres personas leen cada historia antes de que la elijan.
notes: GV Editorial Policy (read 2026-10-02): some editing for clarity, styling and length; at least three members read and forward the story; no changes once published. Paraphrased. research.md A7, C8. La Vina's Politica Editorial follows the same principles (A7).

text_en: In 1954, delegates were asked to suggest that each group appoint a Grapevine reporter to handle subscriptions and encourage members to send in stories. Today's GVRs and RLVs still do both.
credit_en: Source: Advisory Actions (M-39), p. 51; The A.A. Service Manual, 2024–2026, p. 83
title_es: Antes de los GVR: los reporteros de Grapevine
text_es: En 1954 se pidió a los delegados sugerir que cada grupo nombrara un reportero de Grapevine, encargado de las suscripciones y de animar a los miembros a enviar historias. Hoy los RLV y GVR siguen haciendo ambas cosas.
credit_es: Fuente: Acciones Recomendables (M-39, en inglés), p. 51; The A.A. Service Manual (en inglés), 2024–2026, p. 83
notes: 1954 Conference resolution, M-39 Advisory Actions 1951–2026, p. 51: delegates to suggest 'that each group appoint a Grapevine reporter who will be responsible for subscription and bulk orders, and who will encourage members to submit articles and stories'. Read in the official copy on 2026-10-02. Not in research.md: confirmed by the fact-checker in the official M-39 (the aa.org address forwards to the copy on aaws.widen.net) on 2026-10-03; the next year (1955, same page) the Conference committee endorsed 'a Grapevine representative at the group level'. Last sentence: Service Manual 2024–2026 p. 83 (GVRs and RLVs make sure members know how to subscribe or submit stories).

text_en: Grapevine has videos in American Sign Language (ASL) for Deaf alcoholics, listed in AA's Accessibility Resources. Find them in the ASL playlist on the official YouTube channel.
title_es: Grapevine en lengua de señas americana
text_es: Grapevine tiene videos en lengua de señas americana (ASL) para alcohólicos sordos, incluidos en los Recursos de Accesibilidad de AA. Búscalos en la lista de reproducción de ASL del canal oficial de YouTube.
credit_es: Fuente: Recursos de Accesibilidad de AA (OSG, 2025)
notes: GSO 'Accessibility Resources' (Oct. 2025, on aa.org; read 2026-10-03) lists 'AA Grapevine ASL Videos for Deaf Alcoholics' under Deaf/Hard of Hearing resources (research.md A5, High). Playlist 'American Sign Language' on the official channel UCI9uFLJ__aXT3-At0PlPWUQ (data/site/videos.json; config/site.yml links.asl_playlist); AA Grapevine's ASL announcement (July 2024, aagrapevine.org) names the same playlist. No video count (18 is Medium; the playlist now shows 21). Reviewer: source_url checked 2026-10-03: the document (General Service Office Service Material, 'Accessibility Resources') lists 'AA Grapevine ASL Videos for Deaf Alcoholics' under D(d)eaf/Hard of Hearing Resources > American Sign Language.

text_en: The name was meant to suggest an informal yet powerful way of passing the word along, like news heard “through the grapevine.” The first issue came out in June 1944.
text_es: En inglés, las noticias que corren de boca en boca llegan «through the grapevine» (por la vid). El nombre quería sugerir esa forma informal pero poderosa de comunicarse. El primer número salió en junio de 1944.
notes: P-52 (rev. 2026), p. 13: 'the first issue of Grapevine -- whose title was meant to suggest an informal but powerful way to communicate -- was published in June 1944'. The 'through the grapevine' idiom is our own gloss of that sentence. NOT about La Viña's name: no official source explains it (aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina read 2026-10-02), so no La Viña name fact.

title_en: Our meeting in print, in Spanish
text_en: La Viña is the meeting in print of Spanish-speaking AA members. Most of its stories, interviews and articles are written in Spanish; a few pieces are translated from Grapevine.
text_es: La Viña es la reunión impresa de los miembros de AA de habla hispana. La mayoría de sus historias, entrevistas y artículos se escriben en español, y algunos textos vienen traducidos del Grapevine.
notes: Paraphrase of La Viña's Statement of Purpose (P-52, p. 4; Grapevine material - do not quote it) and P-52, p. 8 ('original Spanish-language stories'); 'Historia de La Viña' ('la mayor parte' original Spanish). 'Nuestra reunión impresa': La Viña's Política Editorial (aalavina.org/recursos).

text_en: Many groups give La Viña to newcomers and to members celebrating an anniversary. Some send subscriptions to libraries, hospitals and correctional facilities. Your group conscience decides.
text_es: Muchos grupos le regalan La Viña al recién llegado y a quien celebra su aniversario. Otros mandan suscripciones a bibliotecas, hospitales o cárceles. Lo decide la conciencia de tu grupo.
notes: Manual del Representante de La Viña (2025), p. 6 (many groups give magazines to newcomers and to members celebrating an anniversary; some send subscriptions to professionals, libraries, prisons, hospitals and treatment centers); P-52 (2026), p. 8. Tradition Four: the group decides. Spanish reworded in our own words.

text_en: In Spanish, on Zoom: one Thursday a month at 2 p.m. Central (3 p.m. Eastern), Zoom ID 815 9593 1777. The latest on La Viña, its books and other items, with time for your suggestions. Check aalavina.org's calendar for the dates.
title_es: Taller mensual y virtual de La Viña
text_es: En español, por Zoom: un jueves al mes a las 2 p. m. hora del Centro (3 p. m. del Este), Zoom ID 815 9593 1777. Novedades de La Viña, sus libros y otros productos, con espacio para tus sugerencias. Consulta las fechas en el calendario de aalavina.org.
credit_es: Fuente: Noticias de La Viña, sept.-oct. 2026
notes: La Viña News Sept.-Oct. 2026, p. 3 (purpose: the latest on La Viña, its products, suggestions and more; 3:00 pm ET; Zoom ID; 'Consulta las fechas en aalavina.org/calendario-de-eventos'). Name 'Taller Mensual y Virtual de La Viña': La Viña's Instagram post of Mar. 10, 2024 (its older list of contents is not used). Calendar entries (re-checked 2026-10-02) are all on Thursdays since late 2024, usually the 4th, not reliably the last (research.md caution 6) - so no weekday rule on screen.

text_en: According to La Viña's flyer: from Nov. 5, 2026, a virtual open AA meeting in Spanish every Thursday at 11 a.m. Central (12 p.m. Eastern). Two members share their stories; it's recorded as a podcast. Zoom 871 2036 8287, passcode 238047.
title_es: Reunión abierta semanal de La Viña
text_es: Según el volante de La Viña: a partir del 5 de noviembre de 2026, una reunión abierta virtual de AA en español cada jueves a las 11 a. m. hora del Centro (12 p. m. del Este). Comparten dos miembros y se graba como podcast. Zoom 871 2036 8287, código 238047.
notes: Official La Viña flyer 'Nueva reunión abierta de La Viña' (aagrapevine-ops/decks/sources): Thursdays 12 p.m. Eastern from Nov. 5, 2026; two members share their recovery story; recorded as a new podcast; Zoom 871 2036 8287, passcode 238047; config/site.yml lavina_weekly_open. 'In Spanish': La Viña News Sept.-Oct. 2026, p. 2. No aalavina.org page or calendar entry yet (re-checked 2026-10-02): the text names the flyer, per research.md Open question 2; re-check before each event. Assembly: source_url is our /meetings/#weekly-open, which shows the flyer's details and links to the flyer (research.md A5; aalavina.org has no page for the meeting yet).

text_en: 1996–2026: thirty years of members' experience, strength and hope in Spanish, six issues a year, with stories by Spanish-speaking members in the U.S., Canada and around the world.
text_es: 1996–2026: treinta años de experiencia, fortaleza y esperanza compartidas en español por los miembros, seis números al año, con historias de miembros de habla hispana en EE. UU., Canadá y el resto del mundo.
notes: 'La Viña 30 Aniversario' postcard (1996-2026, '30 años de experiencia, fortaleza y esperanza') and La Viña Hoy (Rev. 3/25), both at aalavina.org/recursos; RLV Manual (2025), p. 4 (six issues a year; stories by Spanish-speaking alcoholics in the U.S., Canada and the rest of the world); research.md A2 (July 2026, High).

text_en: A registered RLV receives a free copy of La Viña every two months for one year, to use in the service position. Free RLV resources, like the RLV Manual, are at aalavina.org/recursos.
text_es: El RLV inscrito recibe gratis un ejemplar de La Viña cada dos meses durante un año, para usarlo en su puesto de servicio. Los recursos gratuitos, como el Manual del RLV, están en aalavina.org/recursos.
notes: Manual del Representante de La Viña (2025), p. 7; research.md B3.

text_en: With La Viña's Carry the Message gift certificate (Lleva el Mensaje), you give a subscription to someone you don't know: La Viña assigns it to an alcoholic in need, for example in a prison or a treatment center.
text_es: Con el certificado de regalo Lleva el Mensaje de La Viña, regalas una suscripción a alguien que no conoces: La Viña la asigna a un alcohólico que la necesita, por ejemplo en una prisión o un centro de tratamiento.
notes: aalavina.org/lleva-el-mensaje (re-read 2026-10-02: a certificate for someone you don't know, e.g. an alcoholic in prison; La Viña redeems it for an alcoholic in need); La Viña Hoy (Rev. 3/25): reaches alcoholics in treatment centers and prisons; P-52 (2026), p. 10; research.md A6. Called a gift certificate, per research.md D4. No price on screen (prices change; /shop/ has them).

text_en: From September 1991 to June 1996, Grapevine ran articles in Spanish. In 1995 the General Service Conference backed a Spanish-language edition, and La Viña’s first issue came off the press in 1996.
text_es: La Viña tuvo un antecedente: de septiembre de 1991 a junio de 1996, Grapevine publicó artículos en español. En 1995, la Conferencia de Servicios Generales apoyó una edición en español, y el primer número de La Viña salió en 1996.
notes: Read 2026-10-02: 'These articles appeared regularly between September 1991 until June 1996'; 1995 Conference 'gave its approval to the idea'; first issue 'June of 1996' — year only on screen (month differs between sources: research.md A2, OQ 21). Also M-39, pp. 55–56; P-52, p. 7. Note: the RLV Manual 2025, p. 3, says the Conference approved the Spanish edition 'en 1996'; the history page and M-39, p. 56 (the Advisory Actions) say 1995, so 1995 stays.

text_en: No need to call a story line: record your story on a smartphone as a WAV or MP3 file and email it. Grapevine: webcoord@aagrapevine.org. La Viña (in Spanish): manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org.
text_es: No hace falta llamar a una línea: graba tu historia en tu teléfono como archivo WAV o MP3 y envíala por correo electrónico. La Viña (en español): manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org. Grapevine (en inglés): webcoord@aagrapevine.org.
notes: GV: aagrapevine.org/audio-portal (read 2026-10-02): smartphone or digital recorder, WAV and MP3, send to webcoord@aagrapevine.org. LV: owner's decision 2026-10-02 (RESUME.md round 4, r4-fix3) = every La Viña story, recordings included, goes to manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org, as /contribute/#record shows (config links.lv_email_editorial); manuscritoslv@ is the address on aalavina.org/guia-para-contribuciones. FLAG: aalavina.org/graba-tu-historia (read 2026-10-02) gives lveditorial@aagrapevine.org for WAV/MP3 files - kept manuscritoslv@ per the owner's decision. lveditorial@ is used ONLY as the monthly workshop's contact.

text_en: Grapevine's workshop guidelines suggest 1½ to 2 hours: about 30 minutes of reading or sharing for inspiration, about 30 minutes of writing, then time to read aloud for anyone who wants to. Our committee can help you plan one.
title_es: Cómo es un taller de escritura
text_es: Las pautas de Grapevine para talleres sugieren de 1½ a 2 horas: unos 30 minutos de lectura o de compartir para inspirarse, unos 30 minutos para escribir y luego tiempo para leer en voz alta, para quien quiera. Nuestro comité puede ayudarte a planear uno.
credit_es: Fuente: pautas para talleres de escritura, aagrapevine.org
notes: Writing Workshop Guidelines (aagrapevine.org/gvr-resources, dated 1.12.21): plan 1.5-2 hours, ~30 min reading/sharing, ~30 min writing, then reading aloud, with a break. Paraphrased. research.md C11. Committee offer = /contribute/#workshop (read.contrib.ws_text).

text_en: Grapevine's form asks you to confirm your story is original and not submitted anywhere else, and to transfer its copyright to AA Grapevine, Inc. if it's accepted. La Viña sends accepted writers a letter to sign the copyright release.
title_es: Tu historia y los derechos de autor
text_es: Cuando La Viña acepta una historia, le envía a quien la escribió una carta para firmar la cesión de los derechos de autor. El formulario de Grapevine pide confirmar que la historia es original y que no se envió a otra publicación, y ceder sus derechos de autor a AA Grapevine, Inc. si la aceptan.
notes: GV submit form 'Copyright Transfer' (read 2026-10-02): assign copyright to the Publisher; work original, not under consideration or submitted elsewhere. LV guidelines (read 2026-10-02): accepted writers get a letter to sign their copyright. research.md C8.

title_en: What a rep can show you
text_en: How to get the Grapevine and La Viña apps, subscribe in print or digital, explore the Story Archive, find the audio stories and podcasts, and how Carry the Message gifts work.
title_es: Lo que un representante te puede mostrar
text_es: Cómo obtener las aplicaciones de La Viña y Grapevine, suscribirte a la edición impresa o digital, explorar el archivo de historias, encontrar las historias en audio y los podcasts, y cómo funcionan los regalos de Lleva el Mensaje.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 12: reps can show members how to download the apps, subscribe (print or digital), explore the Story Archive, find the audio stories and podcasts, and explain Carry the Message gift subscriptions. Paraphrased; checked 2026-10-02.

title_en: A group subscription is a group expense
text_en: AA's pamphlet on self-support (F-3) lists Grapevine literature among a group's basic expenses, with rent, refreshments and AA literature. The group conscience decides.
credit_en: Source: F-3, Self-Support: Where Money and Spirituality Mix, p. 7
title_es: La suscripción del grupo es un gasto del grupo
text_es: El folleto de AA sobre el automantenimiento (F-3) incluye la literatura de Grapevine entre los gastos básicos de un grupo, junto con el alquiler, los refrigerios y la literatura de AA. La conciencia de grupo decide.
notes: F-3 (updated June 2026) p. 7: basic group expenses include 'rent, refreshments, A.A. literature, Grapevine literature, local meeting lists, GSR travel'. research.md A4; checked 2026-10-02.

text_en: A gift certificate for someone you know (a family member, a sponsee, a doctor's office), or a Carry the Message gift for someone you don't know: the magazine office places it with an alcoholic in need.
text_es: Un certificado de regalo para alguien que conoces (un familiar, un ahijado, un consultorio médico), o un regalo de Lleva el Mensaje para alguien que no conoces: la oficina de la revista se lo entrega a un alcohólico que lo necesita.
notes: aagrapevine.org/2023-carry-message-project ('Give a Gift Certificate to a family member, a friend, a sponsee, or a doctor's office' / a Carry the Message Gift Certificate 'to someone you do not know'); aalavina.org/lleva-el-mensaje. research.md A6; checked 2026-10-02.

text_en: Serving as a GVR or RLV can be a gateway to wider service: as a district or Area rep, at Regional Forums and assemblies, and at tables alongside CPC, PI, Corrections, Treatment and other committees.
text_es: Servir como RLV o GVR puede abrir la puerta a más servicio: como representante de distrito o de Área, en los Foros Regionales y las asambleas, y en mesas junto a CCP, IP, Correccionales, Tratamiento y otros comités.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 12: the position 'can also be a gateway to wider circles of service' (district and area reps, Regional Forums, assemblies; co-serving with CPC, PI, Corrections, Literature, Treatment, Bridging the Gap, Accessibilities, Archives). research.md B4; paraphrased; checked 2026-10-02. Fact-check 2026-10-03: 'district and Area service' narrowed to P-52's own example (GVRs and RLVs for districts or areas), and 'assemblies' added as P-52 says.

title_en: Announcements in a minute or two
text_en: A rep's announcement can be short: one or two minutes, with a different topic each time. Hold up the new issue, name its theme, point out what else is inside, or share upcoming themes for writers.
title_es: Anuncios de uno o dos minutos
text_es: El anuncio de un representante puede ser breve: uno o dos minutos, con un enfoque distinto cada vez. Muestra el número nuevo, di su tema, señala qué más trae o comparte los próximos temas para quienes quieran escribir.
credit_es: Fuente: GVR Workbook (2026, en inglés), p. 33
notes: GVR Workbook March 2026 p. 33 (1–2 minute announcements, rotating topics), paraphrased; research.md B5; checked 2026-10-02. Fact-check 2026-10-03: 'a story you liked' is the Workbook's tip for book announcements (p. 40), not p. 33; the tips are now p. 33's own (hold up an issue; the featured section's theme; the other articles inside; upcoming featured sections for members who want to submit).

text_en: On public websites and social media, AA anonymity works like press, radio and film: no full names or full-face photos of members. The usual form is a first name and last initial.
text_es: En sitios web públicos y redes sociales, el anonimato de AA funciona como en la prensa, la radio y el cine: sin nombres completos ni fotos de la cara de los miembros. Lo usual es el nombre de pila y la inicial del apellido.
credit_es: Fuente: P-47 (en inglés), pp. 10–11; SMF-197, p. 1
notes: P-47 (rev. Sept. 2026) pp. 10–11; SMF-197 Anonymity Online and Digital Media p. 1 (research.md Q15, Q17, D2). Paraphrased; checked in the official copies 2026-10-02.

text_en: Every day, Grapevine's Daily Quote and La Viña's Cita Diaria share a short line from published stories. Both are free, by email and on each magazine's home page.
text_es: Cada día, la Cita Diaria de La Viña y el Daily Quote de Grapevine comparten una frase breve de historias publicadas. Ambos son gratis, por correo electrónico y en la página principal de cada revista.
notes: aagrapevine.org home: sign up to receive GV's Daily Quote (read 2026-10-02); Workbook 2026 p. 38 (quotes from stories published by Grapevine, by email each morning, at no expense); La Viña News Sept.-Oct. 2026 p. 2 (sign up free for the Cita Diaria by email at aalavina.org); research.md A5 (High). 'From stories in their pages' changed to 'from published stories': La Viña's Cita Diaria can come from a translated Grapevine book (the Oct. 2, 2026 one cites 'I Am Responsible'). Never paste a Daily Quote into the CSV (GV copyright); the live-quote channel shows today's with its attribution.

text_en: In 2012, a General Service Conference Advisory Action opened the way for members to record their stories by phone. Recorded stories go through the same editorial process as printed ones.
text_es: En 2012, una Acción Recomendable de la Conferencia de Servicios Generales abrió el camino para que los miembros grabaran sus historias por teléfono. Las historias grabadas pasan por el mismo proceso editorial que las impresas.
credit_es: Fuente: Acciones Recomendables de la Conferencia (M-39)
notes: M-39 Advisory Actions 1951-2026, p. 57 (2012: call-in audio strategy; same editorial process) — research.md A2 and C9 (High). Reviewer: source_url is aa.org's M-39 link; on 2026-10-03 it redirected to aaws.widen.net M-39_Advisory_Actions_ONLINE.pdf, the 1951-2026 edition, p. 57.

text_en: Registered Grapevine reps get a monthly email. Grapevine News (monthly) and La Viña's Noticias (every two months) are on the rep resource pages: aagrapevine.org/gvr-resources and aalavina.org/recursos.
text_es: Las Noticias de La Viña (cada dos meses) y Grapevine News (cada mes) están en las páginas de recursos: aalavina.org/recursos y aagrapevine.org/gvr-resources. Los representantes registrados de Grapevine reciben además un correo mensual.
notes: research.md A5 'Newsletters for reps' and B3 (High; Workbook p. 50). aagrapevine.org/gvr-resources shows a 'Grapevine News' section and aalavina.org/recursos the 'Noticias de La Viña' (Sept./Oct.), both read 2026-10-03. Spanish text reordered so La Viña comes first. Registration: aagrapevine.org/get-involved/become-grapevine-rep and aalavina.org/servicio/conviertete-en-rlv. Spanish twin page: {site_es}gvr/.

text_en: Six AA members in the New York area, four women and two men, publish the first Grapevine with Bill W.'s blessing, just nine years after AA began.
text_es: Seis miembros de AA del área de Nueva York, cuatro mujeres y dos hombres, publican el primer Grapevine con la bendición de Bill W., apenas nueve años después del comienzo de AA.
notes: Also Service Manual 2024-2026, App. T, p. 170 (research.md A2). No founders' names (anonymity).

text_en: At the request of the groups, the Grapevine becomes the national journal of Alcoholics Anonymous.
text_es: A petición de los grupos, el Grapevine se convierte en la revista nacional de Alcohólicos Anónimos.
notes: Also Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 79. Not 'a Fellowship-wide vote' (unverified wording in config/history.yml).

text_en: In a Grapevine article, Bill W. first sets out the points that would become AA's Twelve Traditions.
text_es: En un artículo del Grapevine, Bill W. expone por primera vez los puntos que llegarían a ser las Doce Tradiciones de AA.
notes: Also aa.org/aa-grapevine-la-vina ('April 1946 article'); P-52, p. 5. The article's title differs between sources, so none is given (research.md Open question 22).

text_en: The AA Preamble is first published in the Grapevine. A Grapevine editor wrote it, drawing on the Big Book's Foreword, to say what AA is and what it is not.
text_es: El Preámbulo de AA se publica por primera vez en el Grapevine. Lo escribió un editor del Grapevine, basándose en el Prólogo del Libro Grande, para decir qué es AA y qué no es.
notes: P-52, p. 5; Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 170; aagrapevine.org/aa-grapevines-contributions-aa (first appearance in the June 1947 issue; 'what AA is and what it is not').

text_en: The Grapevine changes from a three-column newsletter to the handy digest size it still has today.
text_es: El Grapevine pasa de ser un boletín de tres columnas al práctico tamaño compacto (tipo digest) que conserva hasta hoy.
notes: Only the year is verified ('Sept. 1948' is not; research.md A2).

text_en: With readers now in Canada and Europe, the Grapevine becomes “the international journal of Alcoholics Anonymous.” By January 1949, its masthead says so.
text_es: Con lectores ya en Canadá y Europa, el Grapevine pasa a ser «la revista internacional de Alcohólicos Anónimos». Para enero de 1949, así lo dice su cabecera.
notes: Masthead by Jan. 1949: Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 79. Canada and Europe: aagrapevine.org/history-aa-grapevine ('Four years later', i.e. after 1945).

text_en: The General Service Conference forms a committee on the Grapevine. Since 2020, it has been the Conference Committee on Grapevine and La Viña.
text_es: La Conferencia de Servicios Generales forma un comité dedicado al Grapevine. Desde 2020, su nombre incluye también a La Viña.
notes: 1954: P-52, p. 7; GVR Handbook 2024, p. 13. Renamed in 2020: M-39 Advisory Actions 1951-2026, p. 57 (research.md A2).

text_en: Bill W.'s writings for the Grapevine are gathered in one book: The Language of the Heart.
text_es: Los escritos de Bill W. para el Grapevine se reúnen en un libro: El Lenguaje del Corazón.
credit_es: Fuente: Acciones Recomendables (M-39, ed. en inglés), p. 55
notes: Year: M-39 Advisory Actions of the General Service Conference 1951-2026, p. 55 (1988 action; research.md A2) - no web page gives the year. Content (all of Bill W.'s Grapevine writings): the store page in source_url. Spanish title as in P-52 (2026), p. 18 and aalavina.org/tienda/el-lenguaje-del-corazon.

text_en: At 65, the Grapevine gets a makeover: full color throughout and no staples, so it can go into prisons that don't allow them. Today it has 64 pages.
text_es: A sus 65 años, el Grapevine se renueva: a todo color de principio a fin y sin grapas, para que pueda entrar en las prisiones que no las permiten. Hoy tiene 64 páginas.
notes: 65th anniversary, March 2009, full color and staple-free: evolution page. Reason: GVR Handbook 2024, p. 7 (staple-free so it can be in all institutions, including those that prohibit stapled materials; checked 2026-10-03). The Workbook 2026, p. 11 only says it is bound without staples.

text_en: At the request of Spanish-speaking members, made through the service structure, the Conference recommended that Grapevine print at least one article in Spanish in each issue. These articles ran from September 1991 to June 1996.
text_es: A pedido de miembros de habla hispana, hecho a través de la estructura de servicio, la Conferencia recomendó que el Grapevine publicara al menos un artículo en español en cada número. Esos artículos salieron de septiembre de 1991 a junio de 1996.
notes: aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina (Sept. 1991-June 1996); 'Historia de La Viña' (aalavina.org/recursos: requested by Spanish-speaking members through the service structure); 1991 Advisory Action (M-39, p. 55: at least one article in Spanish in each month's issue).

text_en: The General Service Conference backed a Spanish-language edition of Grapevine and asked the General Service Board to fund it, from its Reserve Fund, for a trial period of up to five years.
text_es: La Conferencia de Servicios Generales respaldó una edición del Grapevine en español y pidió a la Junta de Servicios Generales financiarla con su Fondo de Reserva durante un periodo de prueba de hasta cinco años.
notes: P-52 (2026), p. 7 (the Conference endorsed a Spanish-language edition and asked the General Service Board to finance it for an experimental period not to exceed five years); M-39, p. 56 (funding for up to five years from the GSB Reserve Fund); aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina. Worded 'backed' on purpose (research.md caution 4).

text_en: A special Spanish edition of Grapevine came out, with articles that had first appeared in the English magazine: a first taste of what was coming.
text_es: Salió una edición especial del Grapevine en español, con artículos traducidos de la revista en inglés: un anticipo de lo que vendría.
notes: aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina; 'Historia de La Viña' (aalavina.org/recursos).

text_en: La Viña's first issue came off the press. The magazine for Spanish-speaking AA members was planned from the start to come out every two months. Many early subscriptions came from Spanish-speaking groups and from corrections and treatment committees.
text_es: Salió de la imprenta el primer número de La Viña, pensada desde el principio como revista bimestral para los miembros de AA de habla hispana. Muchas de las primeras suscripciones llegaron de grupos hispanos y de comités de correccionales y de tratamiento.
notes: P-52 (2026), p. 7 (first bimonthly edition in 1996; many subscriptions from Spanish-language groups and from correctional and treatment facilities committees); aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina ('planned as a bimonthly'). Month left out on purpose (June vs July 1996; research.md Open question 21).

text_en: Seeing La Viña work as a Twelfth Step tool, the General Service Conference recommended that AA Grapevine, Inc. keep publishing it, supported by the General Service Board as a service to the Fellowship.
text_es: Al ver que La Viña funcionaba como herramienta del Paso Doce, la Conferencia de Servicios Generales recomendó que AA Grapevine, Inc. siguiera publicándola, con el apoyo de la Junta de Servicios Generales, como un servicio a la Comunidad.
notes: P-52 (2026), pp. 7-8 (mindful of the magazine's effectiveness as a Twelfth Step tool, the 2001 Conference recommended it continue); M-39, p. 56; aagrapevine.org/history-aa-lavina. Paraphrased (the Advisory Action wording is not quoted).

text_en: The Grapevine and La Viña YouTube channel opened. Among its videos is La Viña's own story, told in Spanish: scan to watch it on the official channel.
text_es: Nació el canal de YouTube de La Viña y Grapevine. Entre sus videos está la historia de La Viña, contada en español: escanea para verla en el canal oficial.
notes: P-52 (2026), p. 10 (channel launched 2018). Video: 'La Viña: Su historia y el impacto en la Comunidad Hispana de AA' (data/site/videos.json: official channel UCI9uFLJ__aXT3-At0PlPWUQ, 489 s = 8:09, not live, not a Short; linked by QR only, not played on screen; config/site.yml about_videos).

text_en: The General Service Conference recognizes AA Grapevine as the international journal of Alcoholics Anonymous, a recognition that today extends to La Viña.
text_es: La Conferencia de Servicios Generales reconoce a AA Grapevine como la revista internacional de Alcohólicos Anónimos, un reconocimiento que hoy se extiende también a La Viña.
notes: Service Manual 2024-2026, p. 85 (FAQ 5); M-39, p. 54 (1985 said 'an', corrected to 'the' in 1986). Never write 'Conference-approved'.

text_en: Maintaining an “informative attitude” in all Grapevine presentation plans, rather than “hard sell” promotion, be continued.
credit_en: 1960 Advisory Action. Reprinted from Advisory Actions of the General Service Conference of Alcoholics Anonymous, 1951–2026, p. 52, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: M-39 Advisory Actions 1951–2026, p. 52 (1960), word for word (research.md Q14; checked in the official copy 2026-10-02). The year label goes in the credit, as the round-4 decks do for Traditions. English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md. Quotation marks as printed in M-39 p. 52 (checked 2026-10-03). Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: A.A. members are encouraged to submit articles even though they may think their grammar and spelling aren't perfect.
credit_en: Reprinted from The A.A. Service Manual, 2024–2026 Edition, p. 85, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: research.md Q13, word for word, with its exact credit line (was fact-write-grammar-manual; made a quote at assembly so the passage shows as a quotation and the quote type reaches its range). English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md (the Spanish side: truefalse-write-grammar). Verified 2026-10-02 in BM-31, p. 85, FAQ 7. Re-check the page number when the 2026–2028 edition is out.

text_en: I am responsible. When anyone, anywhere, reaches out for help, I want the hand of AA always to be there. And for that: I am responsible.
credit_en: Responsibility Statement, written for the 1965 International Convention, Toronto
text_es: Yo soy responsable. Cuando cualquiera, dondequiera, extienda su mano pidiendo ayuda, quiero que la mano de AA siempre esté allí. Y de esto: yo soy responsable.
credit_es: Declaración de Responsabilidad, escrita para la Convención Internacional de 1965, Toronto
notes: EN: word for word as aagrapevine.org/about-us prints it (the 'Responsibility Declaration'; the same wording is in the GVR Workbook 2026 p. 2 and the GV Handbook 2024 p. 4). Fact-check 2026-10-03: research.md Q3's text mixed two printings ('I am responsible.' as Grapevine prints it, 'A.A.' as P-52 does; P-52's back cover reads 'I am responsible… When anyone, anywhere, reaches out for help, I want the hand of A.A. always to be there…'); research.md D3 says to pick one source and copy it exactly, so the English now matches the cited source_url; the words are unchanged (A.A. -> AA only). ES: Manual del RLV 2025 p. 2, word for word (Q4; checked 2026-10-03). No copyright line exists: source note only, no author's name. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: This we owe to A.A.'s future: To place our common welfare first; to keep our Fellowship united. For on A.A. unity depend our lives and the lives of those to come.
credit_en: A Declaration of Unity. Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), back cover, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) back cover, word for word (research.md Q5; checked 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of this passage. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: Our common welfare should come first; personal recovery depends upon A.A. unity.
credit_en: Tradition One (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6; checked 2026-10-02). The Tradition's name goes in the credit, as in the round-4 information-workshop deck. English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: For our group purpose there is but one ultimate authority — a loving God as He may express Himself in our group conscience. Our leaders are but trusted servants; they do not govern.
credit_en: Tradition Two (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6, High; D1 lists it among the Traditions most relevant to Grapevine presentations). Added at assembly so the quote type reaches its range. English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. The player puts '— ' before a quote's credit, so the credit has no leading dash. Why here: the committee and the reps inform and suggest; the group conscience decides (research.md D1).

text_en: Each group should be autonomous except in matters affecting other groups or A.A. as a whole.
credit_en: Tradition Four (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6, High; D1 lists it among the Traditions most relevant to Grapevine presentations). Added at assembly so the quote type reaches its range. English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. The player puts '— ' before a quote's credit, so the credit has no leading dash. Why here: many rows say 'each group decides (Tradition Four)' - whether it subscribes, has a GVR or RLV, holds a workshop (research.md D1).

text_en: Each group has but one primary purpose — to carry its message to the alcoholic who still suffers.
credit_en: Tradition Five (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6; checked 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: Every A.A. group ought to be fully self-supporting, declining outside contributions.
credit_en: Tradition Seven (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6; checked 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: Our public relations policy is based on attraction rather than promotion; we need always maintain personal anonymity at the level of press, radio and films.
credit_en: Tradition Eleven (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6; checked 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: Anonymity is the spiritual foundation of all our Traditions, ever reminding us to place principles before personalities.
credit_en: Tradition Twelve (short form). Reprinted from AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print (P-52), p. 17, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: P-52 (2026) p. 17, short form, word for word (research.md Q6; checked 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: research.md has no official Spanish text of the Traditions. Review 2026-10-03: the player itself puts “— ” before a quote's credit and shows a credit on one line (line breaks become spaces), so the credit has no leading dash and the label ends with a period.

text_en: In printed articles, on websites or email, we are identified by our first names and last initials only.
credit_en: Reprinted from Anonymity Online and Digital Media (SMF-197), p. 1, with permission of A.A. World Services, Inc.
notes: research.md Q17, word for word, with its exact credit line (SMF-197, p. 1, quoting The A.A. Group, p. 8; High). Why here: it is how a byline in Grapevine or La Viña protects the writer (see quiz-write-byline). The aa.org page for SMF-197 was confirmed with WebFetch on 2026-10-03. Added at assembly so the quote type reaches its range. English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md.

text_en: GVRs and RLVs, as they are known, are the link between the group and the AA Grapevine office. A.A. members become Grapevine or La Viña reps by volunteering or being elected to the position by their group.
credit_en: Reprinted from The A.A. Service Manual, 2024–2026 Edition, p. 83, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: The A.A. Service Manual 2024–2026 (BM-31) p. 83, word for word (research.md Q11; checked in the official copy 2026-10-02). English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md. Re-check the page number when the 2026–2028 edition comes out.

text_en: AA Grapevine, Inc. is not set up to take contributions from groups or individuals. Groups and individual members support the Grapevine by purchasing Grapevine and La Viña subscriptions and other Grapevine publications and using them in their Twelfth Step work.
credit_en: Reprinted from Self-Support: Where Money and Spirituality Mix (F-3), p. 12, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: F-3 (updated June 2026) p. 12, word for word (research.md Q10; checked in the official copy 2026-10-02). Chosen over Q9 (Service Manual p. 66), which is about 340 characters, over the 300-character limit. English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md.

text_en: In 1986, a Conference Advisory Action stated: “Since each issue of the Grapevine cannot go through the Conference-approval process, the Conference recognizes AA Grapevine as the international journal of Alcoholics Anonymous.” This recognition extends to La Viña as well.
credit_en: Reprinted from The A.A. Service Manual, 2024–2026 Edition, p. 85, with permission of Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc.
notes: The A.A. Service Manual 2024–2026 p. 85, FAQ 5, word for word (research.md Q8; checked in the official copy 2026-10-02). It says 'Conference-approval process' (not the refused phrase). English only on purpose: no official Spanish text in research.md. Quotation marks as printed in the Manual, p. 85 (checked 2026-10-03).

text_en: What's your service connection to Grapevine and La Viña?
choices_en: I'm a GVR or RLV|I serve another way (GSR, DCM…)|Thinking about it|Just curious!
explain_en: Every answer is welcome here. Ask us anything!
text_es: ¿Cuál es tu conexión de servicio con La Viña y Grapevine?
choices_es: Soy RLV o GVR|Sirvo de otra forma (RSG, MCD…)|Lo estoy pensando|¡Solo por curiosidad!
explain_es: Aquí todas las respuestas son bienvenidas. ¡Pregúntanos lo que quieras!
notes: Poll: votes are counted on this device only; no names. GSR = RSG, DCM = MCD in AA Spanish.

text_en: Does your home group have a GVR or RLV right now?
choices_en: Yes!|Not right now|I'm not sure
explain_en: Each group decides for itself (Tradition Four). If yours is curious, ask us how it works.
text_es: ¿Tu grupo base tiene RLV o GVR en este momento?
choices_es: ¡Sí!|Por ahora no|No lo sé
explain_es: Cada grupo decide por sí mismo (Cuarta Tradición). Si al tuyo le interesa, pregúntanos cómo funciona.
notes: Poll: no names, no group names, no ranking; the explanation keeps it pressure-free (Tradition Four; GVR Workbook 2026 p. 52).

text_en: What's your favorite way to carry the message with the magazines?
choices_en: A copy for a newcomer|A Carry the Message gift|A story as a meeting topic|A lending library at my group
explain_en: All of them carry the message!
text_es: ¿Cuál es tu forma favorita de llevar el mensaje con las revistas?
choices_es: Un ejemplar para un recién llegado|Un regalo de Lleva el Mensaje|Una historia como tema de reunión|Una biblioteca de préstamo en mi grupo
explain_es: ¡Todas llevan el mensaje!
notes: Poll. Ideas from the committee's GVR / RLV 101 (config/orientation.yml) and the Manual del RLV 2025 p. 6.

text_en: Grapevine and La Viña come in print, digital and audio. What’s your favorite way?
choices_en: Print, in my hands|Digital, on the app or web|Audio, while I drive or walk|I’m new to them!
explain_en: Both magazines offer an audio version of every issue. Ask us how to listen.
text_es: La Viña y Grapevine vienen en versión impresa, digital y en audio. ¿Cuál es tu forma favorita?
choices_es: Impresa, en mis manos|Digital, en la aplicación o la web|En audio, mientras manejo o camino|¡Apenas las estoy conociendo!
explain_es: Las dos revistas ofrecen una versión en audio de cada número. Pregúntanos cómo escucharla.
notes: Explain: P-52 (2026), p. 10, read 2026-10-02: 'Grapevine and La Viña provide audio versions of every issue for members who prefer to listen at home, in the car or on the go.' Which subscription includes audio is an open question (research.md OQ 8), so no plan is named.

text_en: A new issue lands in your hands. What do you read first?
choices_en: The jokes|The letters|The members’ stories|Page one, in order
explain_en: Members send in all of it: stories, letters and jokes.
text_es: Llega un número nuevo a tus manos. ¿Qué lees primero?
choices_es: Los chistes|Las cartas|Las historias de los miembros|Desde la página uno, en orden
explain_es: Los miembros envían todo eso: historias, cartas y chistes.
notes: Grapevine: jokes for 'At Wit's End' and letters for 'Dear Grapevine', plus first-person stories (aagrapevine.org/guidelines-contributing-grapevine, read 2026-10-02). La Viña: RLV Manual 2025, p. 6 ('Anima a los miembros a colaborar con LA VIÑA escribiendo artículos o cartas, enviando chistes, anécdotas, fotos o dibujos', read 2026-10-02).

text_en: Have you ever written or recorded a story for Grapevine or La Viña?
choices_en: Yes!|Not yet, but I’d like to|Not yet|Wait, I can do that?
explain_en: Yes, you can! Any AA member can send a story, no writing experience needed. Ask us how.
text_es: ¿Alguna vez has escrito o grabado una historia para La Viña o Grapevine?
choices_es: ¡Sí!|Todavía no, pero me gustaría|Todavía no|¿En serio? ¿Yo puedo hacer eso?
explain_es: ¡Sí puedes! Cualquier miembro de AA puede enviar su historia; no hace falta tener experiencia como escritor. Pregúntanos cómo.
notes: A.A. Service Manual 2024–2026, p. 85 (FAQ 6–7); aalavina.org/guia-para-contribuciones (paraphrased, not quoted). Recording: aagrapevine.org/audio-portal, aalavina.org/graba-tu-historia.

text_en: If you wrote a story for Grapevine or La Viña, what would it be about?
choices_en: My first meeting|My sponsor|A Step that changed me|Something funny
explain_en: Tell one experience, the way you’d share it at your home group. Ask us about the upcoming themes.
text_es: Si escribieras una historia para La Viña o Grapevine, ¿de qué se trataría?
choices_es: Mi primera reunión|Mi padrino o madrina|Un Paso que me cambió|Algo chistoso
explain_es: Cuenta una sola experiencia, como la compartirías en tu grupo base. Pregúntanos por los próximos temas.
notes: Tip in the committee's own words (src/_i18n/read.json read.contrib.*; research.md C12). 'Upcoming' rather than 'this year's': in Oct. 2026 the open calls are for 2027 issues (aagrapevine.org/contribute, read 2026-10-02). Themes: /contribute/#deadlines.

text_en: What’s your favorite kind of story?
choices_en: Sponsorship|Spiritual awakenings|Newcomers|Old-timers
text_es: ¿Cuál es tu tipo de historia favorito?
choices_es: Apadrinamiento|Despertares espirituales|Recién llegados|Veteranos
notes: All four are Grapevine departments (aagrapevine.org/evolution-magazine; GVR Handbook p. 7); La Viña has Veteranos and others (Pautas 2020). No explanation needed.

text_en: Have you tried the free Grapevine or La Viña app?
choices_en: Yes|Not yet|Wait, there’s an app?
explain_en: The apps are free to download. To read the magazine in the app, you need a digital or Complete subscription.
text_es: ¿Has probado la aplicación gratuita de La Viña o de Grapevine?
choices_es: Sí|Todavía no|Espera, ¿hay una aplicación?
explain_es: Las aplicaciones se descargan gratis. Para leer la revista en la aplicación se necesita una suscripción digital o completa.
notes: aagrapevine.org/apps read 2026-10-02: free from the App Store and Google Play; 'With a Complete or Digital Subscription…'. Apps since 2023 (P-52, p. 10).

text_en: When do you like to read Grapevine or La Viña?
choices_en: With my morning coffee|On my lunch break|Before bed|Before or after a meeting
text_es: ¿Cuándo te gusta leer La Viña o Grapevine?
choices_es: Con el café de la mañana|A la hora de la comida|Antes de dormir|Antes o después de una reunión
notes: Just for fun; no facts.

text_en: Finished an issue? What happens to it next?
choices_en: I keep it|I pass it to a newcomer|I leave it at my meeting|I share it with my sponsor or sponsee
explain_en: Some groups give issues to newcomers. One copy can carry the message again and again.
text_es: ¿Terminaste un número? ¿Qué haces con él?
choices_es: Lo guardo|Se lo paso a un recién llegado|Lo dejo en mi reunión|Lo comparto con mi padrino, madrina o ahijado
explain_es: Algunos grupos les regalan la revista a los recién llegados. Un ejemplar puede llevar el mensaje una y otra vez.
notes: Paraphrased from the RLV Manual 2025, p. 6 (groups give magazines to newcomers) and the GVR Handbook, p. 12 (an article carries the message every time it is read). Not quoted.

text_en: Ever sent a joke to Grapevine or La Viña?
choices_en: Yes!|Not yet|I’m thinking of one right now
explain_en: Both magazines welcome members’ jokes. Grapevine’s joke page is called At Wit’s End.
text_es: ¿Alguna vez has enviado un chiste a La Viña o a Grapevine?
choices_es: ¡Sí!|Todavía no|Estoy pensando en uno ahora mismo
explain_es: Las dos revistas reciben chistes de los miembros. En Grapevine, la página de humor se llama At Wit’s End.
notes: At Wit's End: aagrapevine.org/evolution-magazine; Workbook pp. 36–37. La Viña asks for jokes: RLV Manual 2025, p. 6; La Viña News Sept.–Oct. 2026, p. 1.

text_en: Who would you love to give a Grapevine or La Viña to?
choices_en: A newcomer|My sponsor|A friend in AA|An alcoholic I’ll never meet
explain_en: That last one is the Carry the Message gift: Grapevine or La Viña sends it to an alcoholic in need. Ask us.
text_es: ¿A quién te gustaría regalarle La Viña o Grapevine?
choices_es: A un recién llegado|A mi padrino o madrina|A un amigo de AA|A un alcohólico que nunca conoceré
explain_es: Esa última opción es el regalo de Lleva el Mensaje: La Viña o Grapevine lo asigna a un alcohólico que lo necesita. Pregúntanos.
notes: research.md A6 (High): Grapevine / La Viña assigns the certificate to an alcoholic in need (prison, treatment center, hospital, homebound); aalavina.org/lleva-el-mensaje. 'Gift', never 'donation'.

text_en: How long have you been reading Grapevine or La Viña?
choices_en: This is my first look!|Less than a year|A few years|Decades!
explain_en: Grapevine has been published since 1944, and La Viña since 1996.
text_es: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevas leyendo La Viña o Grapevine?
choices_es: ¡Es la primera vez que la veo!|Menos de un año|Unos cuantos años|¡Décadas!
explain_es: La Viña se publica desde 1996, y Grapevine desde 1944.
notes: Grapevine June 1944 (aagrapevine.org/history-aa-grapevine); La Viña 1996 (history-aa-lavina; year only, per research.md OQ 21).

text_en: What's the funniest thing that's happened to you in sobriety? Could it become a joke for Grapevine's At Wit's End page?
text_es: ¿Qué es lo más gracioso que te ha pasado en tu vida sobria? ¿Podría convertirse en un chiste para la página At Wit's End de Grapevine?
notes: At Wit's End = Grapevine's jokes page (GV guidelines; research.md C3). Keep it clean: nothing about drinking.

text_en: What's a moment from your first 90 days you'll never forget? It's one of La Viña's suggested story topics. If you write in Spanish, maybe it's your story for La Viña!
text_es: ¿Qué momento de tus primeros 90 días nunca olvidarás? Es uno de los temas que sugiere La Viña. ¡A lo mejor es la historia que puedes compartir con La Viña!
notes: Topic from aalavina.org/temas-sugeridos ('Una anécdota de tus primeros 90 días'), paraphrased. La Viña publishes in Spanish, so the English text says so.

text_en: How did you first come across La Viña or Grapevine: at a meeting, from your sponsor, in a waiting room? Tell us!
text_es: ¿Cómo conociste La Viña o el Grapevine: en una reunión, por tu padrino o madrina, en una sala de espera? ¡Cuéntanos!
notes: Conversation starter; no facts to check. La Viña named first in both languages on purpose (an LV row).

text_en: Does your home group read La Viña at meetings, give it to newcomers or have an RLV? Share an idea that works!
text_es: ¿Tu grupo base lee La Viña en las reuniones, la regala a los recién llegados o tiene RLV? ¡Comparte una idea que funcione!
notes: Ideas from the Manual del Representante de La Viña (2025), p. 6. Experience sharing, no ranking of groups.

text_en: What did your sponsor teach you that you'd love to share with La Viña's readers?
text_es: ¿Qué te enseñó tu padrino o madrina que te gustaría compartir con quienes leen La Viña?
notes: 'Lo que me enseno mi Padrino' is one of La Vina's open topics with no deadline (aalavina.org/temas-sugeridos; research.md C10).

text_en: If you wrote your story for Grapevine or La Viña, what would your very first sentence be?
text_es: Si escribieras tu historia para La Viña o Grapevine, ¿cuál sería tu primera frase?
notes: Conversation prompt for the table. Published stories' openings are discussed in the Writing Workshop Guidelines (research.md C11).

text_en: Has a story in Grapevine or La Viña ever felt like it was written just for you? What was it about?
text_es: ¿Alguna vez una historia de La Viña o de Grapevine te pareció escrita solo para ti? ¿De qué trataba?
notes: Conversation prompt. Stories are talked about, never shown or quoted on screen (Grapevine copyright, research.md D3).

text_en: What's one moment from your sobriety that might help a newcomer if it were in print?
text_es: ¿Qué momento de tu sobriedad podría ayudar a un recién llegado si saliera publicado?
notes: Tip behind it: tell one experience or turning point, not your whole life (research.md C12; /contribute/#tips).

text_en: If the walls of your home group's meeting room could talk, what story would they tell?
text_es: Si las paredes de la sala de tu grupo base hablaran, ¿qué historia contarían?
notes: A wink at Grapevine's If Walls Could Talk photo page (meeting places, no people). Do not claim La Vina has a section by that name (research.md C3).

text_en: Have you served as a GVR or RLV? What would you tell a brand-new rep in one sentence?
text_es: ¿Has servido como RLV o GVR? ¿Qué le dirías en una sola frase a alguien que empieza en ese servicio?
notes: Let's talk. Same question as the round-4 orientation workshop's optional ASK.

text_en: A magazine can go where a meeting can't: a jail cell, a hospital bed, a home someone can't leave. Where have you seen Grapevine or La Viña reach someone?
text_es: Una revista puede llegar a donde una reunión no puede: una celda, una cama de hospital, una casa de la que alguien no puede salir. ¿Dónde has visto que La Viña o Grapevine le llegue a alguien?
notes: Let's talk. 'A magazine can go where a meeting can't' is the committee's own wording (config/orientation.yml, literature-table session).

text_en: Which Step or Tradition would you like to read more stories about? Fun fact: Grapevine’s editors always need stories on Steps 4–12 and every Tradition.
text_es: ¿Sobre qué Paso o Tradición te gustaría leer más historias? Dato curioso: los editores de Grapevine siempre necesitan historias sobre los Pasos 4 al 12 y cada Tradición.
notes: Fact: aagrapevine.org/contribute — editors 'always in need of stories of your experience on Steps 4–12 and on every Tradition' (research.md C2, High); paraphrased.

text_en: How does your group use Grapevine or La Viña: a reading at the meeting, a literature table, gifts for newcomers? Share your ideas with us.
text_es: ¿Cómo usa tu grupo La Viña o Grapevine: una lectura en la reunión, una mesa de literatura, regalos para los recién llegados? Comparte tus ideas con nosotros.
notes: Ideas match the RLV Manual 2025, p. 6 (read 2026-10-02: many groups give magazines to newcomers; some read stories at themed meetings; keep La Viña on display) and the Workbook (research.md B1); the group conscience decides (Tradition Four).

text_en: Upload it with the online form, email it to gveditorial@aagrapevine.org, or mail it to the Editorial Dept. in New York. Keep a copy, and send it just one way. Writing in English? Grapevine is the place.
title_es: Cómo enviar tu historia a Grapevine
text_es: Súbela con el formulario en línea, envíala por correo electrónico a gveditorial@aagrapevine.org o mándala por correo postal al Departamento Editorial en Nueva York. Guarda una copia y envíala por una sola vía. Grapevine recibe historias en inglés.
notes: GV guidelines (read 2026-10-02): upload online, email, or mail to Grapevine, Editorial Dept., 475 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10115; keep a copy; do not submit by both website and email. research.md C6. Email = config links.gv_email_editorial.

text_en: Grapevine's Audio Project lets you share your story by phone for 6 to 8 minutes on one topic, such as making amends or finding your first sponsor, just as you would in a meeting. Scan to see how.
text_es: Con el Audio Project de Grapevine puedes compartir tu historia por teléfono, en inglés, de 6 a 8 minutos sobre un tema, como hacer reparaciones o encontrar a tu primer padrino o madrina, tal como lo harías en una reunión. Escanea para ver cómo.
notes: aagrapevine.org/audio-portal (read 2026-10-02): 6-8 minutes; topic examples making amends / first sponsor; 559-726-1216, press 1 tips + record, # finish, 1 save, 2 permission. The line was reported down in May 2026: test it before an event (research.md C9). Do not mention any subscription requirement (Open question 9). Round 5 (lead): the phone number was taken out of the slide (the line was reported down in May 2026); the QR leads to the official page, which gives the current number.

title_en: Does your group have an RLV?
text_en: The RLV (Representante de La Viña) links the home group with La Viña, sharing each new issue and inviting members to read and write. It's a simple service position. Ask us about it!
text_es: El RLV (Representante de La Viña) es el enlace entre el grupo base y La Viña: comparte cada número nuevo e invita a leer y a escribir. Es un puesto de servicio sencillo. ¡Pregúntanos!
notes: aalavina.org/servicio/conviertete-en-rlv; Service Manual, p. 83. The group decides whether it has an RLV (Tradition Four).

title_en: Sending your story to La Viña
text_en: Use La Viña's online form at aalavina.org/comparte, email it to manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org, or mail it to La Viña in New York. Write it in Spanish, the way you'd share it at your home group.
title_es: Cómo enviar tu historia a La Viña
text_es: Usa el formulario en línea de La Viña en aalavina.org/comparte, envíala por correo electrónico a manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org o mándala por correo postal a La Viña en Nueva York. Escríbela en español, como la compartirías en tu grupo base.
notes: Owner's decision 2026-10-02 (RESUME.md round 4, r4 SPEC UPDATE 4): La Vina story address = manuscritoslv@aagrapevine.org (config links.lv_email_editorial); lveditorial@ only as the monthly workshop's contact - never for stories. Online form: aalavina.org/comparte ('Carga tu historia o foto o ilustracion', read 2026-10-02). Mail: La Vina, 475 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10115.

title_en: Curious about GVR or RLV service?
text_en: It's one of the simplest service positions in AA: the link between your home group and our meeting in print. Ask us at this table. We're glad to share our experience.
title_es: ¿Te interesa el servicio de RLV o GVR?
text_es: Es uno de los puestos de servicio más sencillos de AA: el enlace entre tu grupo base y nuestra reunión impresa. Pregúntanos en esta mesa; con gusto compartimos nuestra experiencia.
notes: Wording follows the site's GVR / RLV corner (src/_i18n/read.json read.gvr.job_text). The QR opens GVR / RLV 101 (six short sessions for new reps).

text_en: Everything at this table is information for your group conscience. Ask questions, take what helps and let your group decide what fits (Tradition Four).
text_es: Todo lo que hay en esta mesa es información para la conciencia de tu grupo. Pregunta, llévate lo que te sirva y deja que tu grupo decida qué le conviene (Cuarta Tradición).
notes: Attraction, not promotion: the 1960 'informative attitude' (M-39 p. 52) and Tradition Four. Heading as in GVR / RLV 101 (config/orientation.yml).

text_en: Grapevine and La Viña, our “meeting in print,” are right here. Take a look, ask us anything or just stop by to say hello.
text_es: Aquí están La Viña y Grapevine, «nuestra reunión impresa». Échales un vistazo, pregúntanos lo que quieras o simplemente pasa a saludar.
notes: No {event}: booth.defaults.event_name is empty by default and the player's fill() drops an empty {event} with the space before it, so the earlier title read 'Welcome to!' / 'Stories everywhere at' / 'Thanks for stopping by at' whenever no event name was set; auto:welcome already greets by event name when one is set, and the header shows it. 'Meeting in print': P-52 (AA Grapevine and La Viña: Our Meetings in Print), p. 13; 'nuestra reunión impresa': RLV Manual 2025, p. 3 (read 2026-10-02). Reworded so the magazines, not the table, are the meeting in print.

text_en: Grapevine and La Viña are written almost entirely by AA members, people just like you. Have a story to tell? Ask us how to send it.
text_es: La Viña y Grapevine están escritas casi en su totalidad por miembros de AA, personas como tú. ¿Tienes una historia? Pregúntanos cómo enviarla.
notes: No {event}: booth.defaults.event_name is empty by default and the player's fill() drops an empty {event} with the space before it, so the earlier title read 'Welcome to!' / 'Stories everywhere at' / 'Thanks for stopping by at' whenever no event name was set; auto:welcome already greets by event name when one is set, and the header shows it. Fact: 'All articles for the magazine are contributed by A.A. members, with the exception of a few by nonalcoholics' (P-52, p. 9, read 2026-10-02); Service Manual, p. 81. No promise of publication.

text_en: The {committee} meets on Zoom every month, and every AA member is welcome. Ask us for the details.
text_es: El {committee} se reúne por Zoom cada mes y todos los miembros de AA son bienvenidos. Pídenos los detalles.
notes: No {event}: booth.defaults.event_name is empty by default and the player's fill() drops an empty {event} with the space before it, so the earlier title read 'Welcome to!' / 'Stories everywhere at' / 'Thanks for stopping by at' whenever no event name was set; auto:welcome already greets by event name when one is set, and the header shows it. {committee} is always filled from booth.json site.committee_en / committee_es (EN 'NETA 65 Grapevine & La Viña Committee' / ES 'Comité de Grapevine y La Viña de NETA 65', hence 'The'/'El'). Committee meeting: 3rd Wednesday, 7 p.m. Central, Zoom; 'All AA members are welcome to attend.' (config/site.yml meeting; research.md E1).

title_en: A gift that carries the message
text_en: For a sponsee, a newcomer or an alcoholic you’ll never meet. Ask us about gift subscriptions and the Carry the Message project.
title_es: Un regalo que lleva el mensaje
text_es: Para tu ahijado, un recién llegado o un alcohólico que nunca conocerás. Pregúntanos por las suscripciones de regalo y el proyecto Lleva el Mensaje.
notes: Carry the Message: aagrapevine.org/2023-carry-message-project (read 2026-10-02: 'Grapevine will redeem the gift certificate(s) for an alcoholic in need'); research.md A6 (High); aalavina.org/lleva-el-mensaje. Title changed from 'make great gifts' (informative attitude, not a sales slogan). 'Gift', never 'donation'; no prices here (they change; /shop/ has the current ones). Review 2026-10-03: the project offers two ways to give. A gift certificate is for someone you know (family, a friend, a sponsee). A Carry the Message gift certificate is for someone you don't know, and Grapevine / La Viña redeems it for an alcoholic in need (aagrapevine.org/2023-carry-message-project; aalavina.org/lleva-el-mensaje). The text names both: 'gift subscriptions and the Carry the Message project'.
